options.label: Principle 9 + done entry (Recommended)
options.description: Extend CLAUDE.md principle 9 and point its 'Measured failure modes' at ADR-0037 plus report § 5; the BACKLOG-DONE entry carries the evidence. No new ADR, smallest change.

9. **A figure or a universal claim names its derivation**:
   a number, a count, a claim about an action you took, or an
   "every", "all" or "never" — in a spec, ADR, ... review reply —
   states the command, query, or enumeration it came from, and
   that derivation is **run before the sentence is written** ...
   Measured failure modes: ADR-0037; for quantifiers,
   report § 5 (SCOPE findings).

options.label: New ADR amending ADR-0037
options.description: ADR-0044 amends ADR-0037's second decision to cover quantifiers, with its own reversal condition. More durable rationale, more text to write and review.

questions.question: Proposals 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7 have no home in the repo. What should be filed?

options.label: File 2+3 and 5 as items (Recommended)
options.description: One BK item for 2+3 (an outcome check and a falsifiable-check clause for closing prose; coordinate with BK-425, which touches the same loop) and one for 5 (smaller reviewer input, measured). 6 and 7 stay notes until a next measured run is planned.

options.label: File all five
options.description: Separate items for 2+3, 5, 6 and 7; complete coverage, but 6 and 7 are about measuring sessions, not deliveries, and may sit idle.

options.label: Wait for BK-425
options.description: File nothing now; BK-425's orient decides whether 2+3 fold into the review contract.

questions.question: The status pointers I added to the two research snapshots likely break 000-process's 'no updates except factual corrections'. What should happen?

options.label: Revert, link from backlog (Recommended)
options.description: Restore the research docs' status lines to their #1114 text; the backlog items and BACKLOG-DONE entries already link to the research, which is the direction the rule expects.

options.label: Keep them
options.description: Treat the pointers as harmless navigation; the rule's text says otherwise, so a later review may flag it.

options.label: Clarify the rule
options.description: Amend 000-process to allow follow-up-ID pointers in a research header; a process change with its own review.

questions.question: Which IDs should this session use for the two new items, given the BK-425 and gate sessions may also mint?

options.label: BK-430 and BK-431 (Recommended)
options.description: Leave BK-426 to BK-429 for the two parallel sessions and take a block above them; tell those sessions their range. Avoids a collision without waiting.

options.label: BK-426 and BK-427
options.description: Next safe IDs now; risks a collision if a parallel session mints before pushing.

options.label: Wait until they push
options.description: Do the snapshot revert now, file the items after the parallel sessions have pushed.
